text.en: Pet owners express strong loyalty to Dr. King Moon, his associate veterinarians, and head veterinary technician Karen. Reviewers praise the clinic team for their kind demeanor, deep clinical experience spanning generations, and dedication to ensuring both pets and owners feel supported.

Clients repeatedly emphasize the staff's ability to safely handle challenging and frightened animals. Multiple owners note that veterinarians stay calm with defensive or reactive dogs, treating pets with gentle patience while ensuring essential diagnostic exams and therapies are completed.

Reviews reflect great confidence in treatment efficacy, noting successful cherry eye corrections, dental surgeries, and specialized medical therapies for feline stomatitis. Clients appreciate that interventions resolve chronic suffering and restore their pets' vitality.

q.en: How do clients rate veterinary care costs at this practice?

a.en: Pet parents highlight that fees are among the most reasonable in the San Fernando Valley without unnecessary diagnostic upselling.

q.en: Does the practice handle reactive or vet-aggressive dogs?

a.en: Yes, reviewers share that the doctors and veterinary technicians manage large, reactive animals with calm expertise.
Clients mention that the hospital moved to an updated facility that offers an improved and comfortable setting for visits.

q.en: Are doctors available for follow-up questions after surgeries?

a.en: Pet owners note that veterinarians remain communicative in the weeks following operations to monitor healing.
